name: mujoco-wasm-play
description: Playground / glue-layer workspace for MuJoCo WASM artifacts.

scripts.smoke: (node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config tests/playwright.config.mjs tests/e2e/default-init-debug.spec.ts || "%npm_node_execpath%" node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config tests/playwright.config.mjs tests/e2e/default-init-debug.spec.ts)
scripts.test:e2e: (node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config tests/playwright.config.mjs || "%npm_node_execpath%" node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config tests/playwright.config.mjs)
scripts.ci: (node tests/tooling/validate_spec.mjs || "%npm_node_execpath%" tests/tooling/validate_spec.mjs) && (node tools/forbid_patterns.mjs || "%npm_node_execpath%" tools/forbid_patterns.mjs) && (node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config tests/playwright.config.mjs --reporter=list --timeout=90000 || "%npm_node_execpath%" node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config tests/playwright.config.mjs --reporter=list --timeout=90000)
